description: Operating system field storing categorical string values. Contains 30 non‑null records with 8 distinct values such as 'Android', 'iOS', 'Linux', 'Windows', and 'macOS'. Observed case inconsistencies (e.g., 'android', 'IOS', 'LINUX', 'macOs') indicate data quality issues.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Normalize case variations to the official OS names: 'android' → 'Android', 'IOS' → 'iOS', 'LINUX' → 'Linux', 'macOs' → 'macOS'.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values belong to the allowed set of operating system names after standardisation.
